answer: Agents could earn voting weight only from unique, nontransferable credentials issued after a person completes an in-person challenge at an independent registrar; credentials expire periodically and are checked for duplicates across registrars. A velvet-smooth fake profile therefore earns no extra influence: the attacker must recruit real people or repeatedly present fabricated identities in person, paying travel, time, and coordination costs. The voyage across an ocean does not help if each credential still requires its holder’s verified presence.
